title: Border Battle
text: After leaving the prison, I’ll head to the Filolial Lodge where Yuki-chan is. By then, things at the gate will have gotten quite chaotic, and it sounds like it’s only a matter of time before they break through.
“I’m done here.”
“So what are you going to do now, Motoyasu-sama?”
“After I meet up with Kou, I’ll head out to reinforce my Father.”

By the time I’m fighting the Three Heroes Church like this, my Father should already have encountered the Siltvelt Army. I recall my Father muttering, “I hope I can persuade them…” How are deities treated when they speak truths that are inconvenient for a nation or a religion? Last time, I made it clear in advance that my sole purpose was to create a stir, and I did not incite the people in any way.
However, this time presents a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for Siltvelt. When my Father stands in their way at a time like this, what kind of thoughts will those in power have?

The problem is that it’s too vague to pinpoint exactly where beyond the Melromarc border my Father is planning to fight. It’s a tough call—whether to fly straight to the area near the Filolial farm or head there from the spot where he stopped while traveling as a peddler. We don’t have much time. I don’t really think my Father will die, but we should still hurry there as quickly as possible.
Hm? It feels like the commotion by the gate is starting to die down, but I don’t have time to worry about that.
“Well then, Yuki-chan, after we meet up with Kou, we’ll rush over to my Father’s side.”
“Understood.”
Riding on Yuki-chan’s back, I leaped over the castle wall to meet up with Kou, then flew near the Filolial Farm before heading toward the Melromarc border.

We could have stopped by the Filolial Farm, but we don’t have time for that right now. I’m rushing Yuki-chan and Kou to launch a surprise attack on the Siltvelt Army, where my Father is likely fighting. As we neared the border of Melromarc, a group that looked like the Siltvelt Army was… having abandoned combat and set up camp.
“What on earth is going on here?”
“I have no idea.”

From the looks of it, they showed no intention of fighting; the moment they saw my face, they raised both hands in a gesture of surrender. What on earth is the commander at the front of the army doing?
“Has the war already ended?”
“I don’t know…”
Yuki-chan tilts her head in confusion.
“What happened to the war?”
“Spear Hero, the God of Shields awaits you at the head of our army. He says you should ask him over there about the situation…”
A Demi-Human who looks like a soldier tells me this. What’s going on here? Did he obediently listen to Father out of deep faith?
I have Yuki-chan and the others run toward the front of the army, just as the Demi-Human soldier said. The area is gradually becoming more ominous, as if to reflect the intensity of the battle.

Everywhere I look, I can see traces of various magic—things charred, flipped over as if overturned, or even submerged. There are even signs of Meteorite magic. With traces of fire as well, it’s plain as day that a battle has taken place.
In a situation like this… if it were me, I’d aim to wipe out the Siltvelt Army with area-of-effect magic and Skills…
“Ah, Motoyasu-kun!”

Ahead of the Siltvelt Army, near where what appears to be the Melromarc Army’s vanguard had clashed, my father-in-law is standing with Keel and Luna-chan. And he’s waving at us while holding the Lazy Pig. Hmm? It looks like there’s a Panda Beastman nearby, and it seems the Queen is standing right next to my father-in-law.
“What on earth happened here?”
I approach my father-in-law, dismount from Yuki-chan, and ask him.
“Well… looking at the results, I suppose we managed to contain the war…?”
“Is that so?”
“It was quite a struggle, though.”
Hmm… It’s a bit of a shame I didn’t get a chance to step in. But how did things end up like this?
“What led to the current situation?”
“Well, that—”
“Before we get into that, let’s get moving.”
The Queen stepped between me and my Father and said,
“Motoyasu, she says it’s time to move on.”
“I understand.”
“Huh? You can understand the Queen’s words?”
“Yes, I can.”

She’s my Finacée’s mother, after all. I’ve matured enough to understand her now. Incidentally, before the loop, my Father was considerate enough to keep me in the dark, even when I understood what was being said.
“…Where are we going?”
“They say to Melromarc Castle. Apparently, the commotion over there is already winding down.”
I’d like to prioritize hearing the details of the war from my Father, but he seems intent on talking about the Queen first.
“Well, why don’t we just talk about it as we go?”
“Are we taking the Queen back to the castle? Then we can just use the portal.”
“Hmm… That’s fine, I guess, but I don’t think the preparations at the castle are ready yet, and Melty probably isn’t mentally prepared either.”
Oh? Why is my Finacée showing up here? She’s supposed to be at the hideout with Sakura, keeping an eye on Itsuki.
“Well, I just heard about this myself, but I’ll explain everything step by step, so come with me.”
“Understood.”
Led by my Father, we set off toward Melromarc Castle. Oh? There are signs of a battle at the fortress on the border of Melromarc.
Are those even Melromarc soldiers the queen is leading? It feels a bit off… but I suppose there are soldiers from other forces mixed in as well. My Father explained what had happened along the way.

My father, who had split off from me, headed toward the fortress on the Melromarc border to persuade the Siltvelt Army. After all, there are no portals. If he went from the Siltvelt side, he wouldn’t make it in time.
“The Shield Demon has appeared! Kill it!”
Apparently, the soldiers of the Three Heroes Church in the Melromarc Army foolishly spotted my Father and, filled with excitement, charged out to engage him.
“The enemy’s right in front of us—what are you doing moving to the rear?! You’re in the way!”
“Iwa, should Luna scatter them?”
“I’ll help too, big bro!”
It seems Keel and Luna asked this as they were racing off on Luna’s back.
“We don’t have time to deal with them. I’ll cast Shooting Star Shield, so Luna, plan to break through head-on and charge straight through the fortress.”
“Got it.”
“Huh? Big bro, aren’t you going to fight here?”

“It’d take too long if I fought here. From the looks of it… it seems half the Melromarc Army is stationed here in preparation for war. The rest… are they probably busy suppressing the Revolutionary Army?”
“That’s the guy with the spear.”
“Well, I’m worried about Motoyasu-kun, but I have to believe he’ll pull it off. We’ve got to buy some time—at least until Motoyasu-kun gets here.”
At that moment, my Father had no idea where the Pope was. As for me, I was just hoping the Pope would be there, so it was pretty much a gamble.
“Shooting Star Shield X!”
My father cast the Shooting Star Shield to create a barrier, and Luna ran straight through it, charging head-on into the border fortress.
“Whoa!”
“Y-you fool! You say you can’t even scratch the Shield Demon?!”
“Get out of my way!”
Everyone who tried to engage her in close combat with Luna’s kicks was cut down without exception. Just like that, my father and the others broke through the border and ran off.

The soldiers guarding the border immediately began to give chase after Father and his group, while Father himself headed straight for the Siltvelt Army, which had closed in right before his eyes. Even the Melromarc Army of the Three Heroes Church, as formidable as they were, desperately tried to cast Ceremonial Magic to stop Father, but it was powerless against Luna’s kicks. In the blink of an eye, they had escaped out of range.
My Father stood in the path of the Siltvelt Army.
“Oh! Well, well, Shield Hero! You have returned from the clutches of the hated Melromarc—the Wise King—whom we had weakened so that you might lead our army.”
The Shusaku representative at the front stepped forward and declared this to Father. Similarly, the Siltvelt Army was raising their voices in what sounded like cheers.
“I’m sorry, but that’s not why I came here.”
Father glared at him and said.
“What…? Is something wrong?”
The representative replied with an expression as if he’d been betrayed.
“Who… told you to march on Melromarc? The messenger who spoke with me must have understood that the purpose was to bring divine punishment upon Melromarc, right?”

“Well… that’s true, but now that the Wise King’s influence is waning and Melromarc is calling for the Shield Hero, what kind of Holy War would this be if we didn’t rush to the scene and occupy Melromarc!”
“Don’t go going around declaring this a Holy War on your own!”
My Father pointed at the representative and declared firmly.

“This world is under threat from the Waves, and I… the Four Saints were summoned for that very purpose. What I was trying to do was… to drain the pus from Melromarc. The revolution was a result of that—it wasn’t a ploy for Siltvelt to occupy the country!”
“Isn’t the result the same?”

“How is it the same!? My goal was to make the people of Melromarc abandon their intention to persecute the Shield Hero… and the Demi-Humans. It’s the path to peace that can only be achieved by avoiding war.”
Apparently, not only was the representative from Siltvelt displeased with my father-in-law’s response, but a murmur also arose among the soldiers.

“In that case, what you’re doing is no different from the Three Heroes Church. Do you have any idea what will happen after you occupy Melromarc…? Demi-humans will be given preferential treatment, and humans will become slaves. You’d be making a huge mistake if you thought I didn’t know that.”
After all, my father had leveled up in Siltvelt many times. He must have had his own thoughts on the relationship between Demi-humans and humans.
I made a few corrections.
